messages.subject: Fixed MaAsLin problem on http://huttenhower.sph.harvard.edu/galaxy/
messages.body_plain:
Hello MaAsLin User Group,

We fixed the problem invoking MaAsLin on the http://huttenhower.sph.harvard.edu/galaxy/  that was issuing the following error:

OSError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/net/rcstore02/ifs/rc_labs/galaxy/www/galaxy_hutlab14/shed_tools/testtoolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/george-weingart/maaslin/2e2afaf45641/maaslin <http://testtoolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/george-weingart/maaslin/2e2afaf45641/maaslin>'
MaAsLin on Galaxy is working again.
Please let me know if you encounter a problem..
We apologize for the problem.
Best regards,

George Weingart,  PhD
Huttenhower Lab
Harvard School of Public Health
